entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. It's the new VeloBand GPS Tracker.

I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just... I don't know, it's so confusing. The interface is really hard to use. I read the user manual twice, and I still can't get the pulse data to show up the way I want during my runs. I honestly expected more for what I paid.
I understand how frustrating that can be when a device doesn't feel intuitive. Let me pull up your account. I see you received the VeloBand on December 15th, about 17 days ago, is that correct?

Yes, that's right. I feel so bad calling about it, but I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for this. I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out for me. I'm just so disappointed.
I appreciate your loyalty, and I want to make this right. Let me just check our current return policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I'm looking at our knowledge base here, and it states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Since you're well within that 90-day timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on your account right now.
Oh, wow! Are you serious? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've really helped me out.

You're very welcome. You should receive that email in the next few minutes. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so understanding.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
